archetypes.name: dyn-review-convergence
archetypes.rationale: Verify prune-to-empty now converges both review loops without altering genuine panel-failure exit paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the review-loop continuation changes in python/plan_review.py (the plan_review_continuation pruned-empty branch) and python/review_and_fix.py (the step5 prune-skipped routing). Confirm a prune-to-empty round now completes the loop immediately instead of launching another round, for both /design and /implement. Critically verify the change is scoped only to the prune-empty path: genuine failure statuses (panel-failed, panel-init-failed, degraded-empty-collector, ballot-items-lost) must still exit through their original branches and must not be silently converged. Check that round provenance is still emitted on the /design terminal degraded_exit path so the reviewed plan publishes (no regression of #5194). Confirm the new converged-pruned-empty reason and the ROUNDS_COMPLETED reporting stay consistent across both skills. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
